name: @rhythmjs/ws
description: Bun-native WebSocket routes for Rhythm: a pipeline you mount into any app, whose routes call Bun's server.upgrade; ws.data is yours and typed per route, pub/sub is Bun's own.

scripts.build: bun build src/rhythm-ws.ts --outdir dist --root src --format esm --target bun --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
